purpose: Regression and release-gate benchmark for biological-protocol-reviewer review behavior.
behavioral_gates: At least one severity-coded finding must contain non-empty problem, evidence, impact, resolution, and decisive-readout fields.
Every must_detect concept must occur inside a complete reasoned finding whose severity meets the case minimum; global keyword inventories do not count.
Readiness must state a numeric 0-10 score and one Level 0-3 maturity value, and the score must fall within that level's rubric range.
A keyword inventory without a reasoned finding cannot pass.
notes: This set uses synthetic, non-sensitive cases only.
CI validates benchmark definitions deterministically; model-output scoring is intended for release evaluation.
